key_facts: The team decided to drop the speech recognition feature.
The team agreed to keep the LCD screen and the advanced chip-on-print.
The team decided to use a single curved design for the product.
The team planned to replace multiple buttons with an integrated scroll-wheel push-button.
The team discussed the cost implications and determined that the integrated scroll-wheel push-button would cost three Euros.
The team concluded that the product design would save a total of thirteen Euros.
The team decided to keep the power button and the menu button.
The team considered using a hand dynamo as a power source but ultimately decided against it.
The team agreed to use plastic with a special color for the product casing.
The team evaluated the design using a seven-point scale and scored it a total of twenty-eight.
The team decided to name the product the Real Remote.
The team discussed the use of a digital pen for design and noted its advantages over traditional tools.
The team acknowledged the need for recalibration of the drawing tool during the meeting.
The team expressed satisfaction with the progress made and the improvements in the design process.
